claims: H-E-B stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
All Central Market locations are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
H-E-B closes its stores to allow employees to spend time with their families.
H-E-B curbside and home delivery services are unavailable on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
H-E-B regular store hours and services resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Walmart will remain open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Kroger will remain open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Some Whole Foods locations will remain open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
